content.title: Cameron Young's huge net worth and major change encouraged by wife
content.text: Cameron Young met his wife, Kelsey Dalition, at Wake Forest University where they both played collegiate golf -Credit:Getty Images (Getty Images)Cameron Young met his wife, Kelsey Dalition, at Wake Forest University where they both played collegiate golf -Credit:Getty Images (Getty Images)Cameron Young competed in his first Ryder Cup last year and did so riding the momentum of finally securing his first PGA Tour win at the Wyndham Championship.Young's selection after receiving a captain's pick from Keegan Bradley represented another sign of the 28-year-old's continued rise on the PGA Tour. And he has picked up where he left off in 2026, fighting Matt Fitzpatrick, who's wife made a big decision as they faced an awkward scenario, for the win in a dramatic finale at The PLAYERS Championship.His breakthrough campaign featured his inaugural victory, combining substantial prize money with an expanding presence away from competition. Beyond the course, his journey is characterized by both financial achievement and the understated yet meaningful backing of his wife, Kelsey Dalition, who has even shaped how he carries himself at golf's premier events.• Matt Fitzpatrick was 'surprised' by Ludvig Aberg personality when he first met him• PGA Tour rookie self-taught from YouTube about to win life-changing money at The PlayersWhat is Cameron Young's net worth?As of 2025, Cameron Young's net worth is projected to be approximately $17 to $18 million.This estimate captures his recent emergence, including his maiden PGA Tour triumph at the Wyndham Championship in early August 2025, where he controlled the field and claimed a considerable winner's check of nearly $1.5 million.Beyond his tournament prizes, his career earnings, including majors, reach $28.8 million according to Spotrac, placing him 108th on the all-time PGA Tour money list. Additional income streams include endorsement deals - he has served as a brand ambassador for firms like Peter Millar and iCapital, among others - further supplementing his earnings off the fairways.Who is Cameron Young's wife?Cameron Young's Wife Young is married to Kelsey Dalition, an exceptionally private person who seldom appears on social media and prefers to keep her personal life out of the spotlight. The couple married in an intimate ceremony in 2021, shortly after Young turned professional, with his former college teammate and caddie, Scott McKean, acting as best man.Cameron Young used to have a very different lookKelsey is believed to be a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) and played collegiate golf at Wake Forest University. Though she keeps a low profile, she regularly attends his tournaments in a supportive capacity, including The Masters Par-3 Contest and the 2025 Genesis Invitational, often with their children by her side.The family resides in Jupiter, Florida, having purchased a home there in 2022 after initially living with Young's parents during the early stages of their relationship. They have three children together, including their eldest, Henry, who was born in 2022.Young's new look wife encouragedOne notable instance that highlighted Kelsey Dalition's subtle influence occurred ahead of the 2023 PGA Championship at Oak Hill Country Club. Known for his distinctive facial hair, Cameron arrived at the tournament clean-shaven, a dramatic change he credited to his wife's suggestion.As he explained, "Honestly, my wife just kind of said, why don't you shave... I haven't been clean‐shaven probably since our first son was born."Rory McIlroy Gets Called Out Again for Giving the Cold Shoulder to His Partner in Masters Final RoundTue, April 14, 2026 at 3:02 PM UTCCameron Young, Rory McIlroyCredit: Maddie Meyer/GettyNEED TO KNOWRory McIlroy didn't interact too much with his playing partner on Sunday at the Masters“I don’t think he really wanted to talk to me today,” Cameron Young told reportersThe interaction echoes McIlroy's behavior with Bryson DeChambeau during the final round last yearIt turns out, being paired with Rory McIlroy while he’s in pursuit of a Masters victory comes with silence, and lots of it. “There is not much,” Cameron Young told reporters, according to the Golf Channel, when he was asked how much he spoke to McIlroy while playing alongside him at Augusta National on Sunday, April 12. “I don’t think he really wanted to talk to me today,” Young, 28, added. “Sunday at the Masters in the final group, you know, don’t wish anything poorly on the guy, but we’re playing against each other. Not trying to be best friends out there.”McIlroy, 36, weathered a roller-coaster round and saw his six-shot lead dwindle but he eventually recovered to pull off a one-shot victory, defending his 2025 title.Rory McIlroy, Cameron YoungCredit: Jared C. Tilton/GettyFor his part, the golfer agreed with Young’s assessment.“There wasn’t a ton of talk out there,” McIlroy said. “I think we both knew what we needed to do. I just needed to step up and execute.”McIlroy’s and Young’s lack of back-and-forth was a case of déjà vu — at least for Bryson DeChambeau.Last year, the LIV golfer had a similar experience when matched with McIlroy in the final round.“[He] didn’t talk to me once all day,” DeChambeau, 32, said at the time. “He wouldn’t talk to me.”McIlroy, on the cusp of finally winning an elusive Grand Slam, said at the time that he wasn’t sure why DeChambeau wanted more.“I don’t know what he was expecting,” McIlroy, 36, told reporters last May when revisiting the controversy. “We’re trying to win the Masters. I’m not going to try to be his best mate out there.”Read the original article on PeopleGolfer Rory McIlroy once sparked dating rumors with Meghan MarkleUpdated Wed, April 15, 2026 at 4:46 PM UTCRory McIlroy tees off on the 5th hole during the third round of the Genesis Invitational in 2025. By: MEGAMeghan Markle and Rory McIlroy spent time together before she married Prince Harry.In a 2014 video, the Duchess of Sussex had a bucket of water poured on her by the golfer as part of the viral ALS Ice Bucket Challenge.“I thought it seemed fitting that the person who nominated me would be the one to dump the ice on me,” Meghan said as McIlroy stood behind her with a large vat of water.After the athlete dumped the liquid on the Suits star, he emphasized what a “good sport” Meghan was.In an update to the With Love, Meghan star’s former blog, The Tig, she raved over her friendship with McIlroy.“Ah, yes. Rory McIlroy. The Rory McIlroy. Whispered [and shouted] to be the foremost golfer in the world, loved by Tiger [Woods], respected by [Arnold] Palmer, and dumper of frigid water onto my lone head for the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge,” she wrote in an August 2014 post via Us Weekly.“That Rory McIlroy. He is a force who has the propensity to actually work hard and play hard — relishing intense practices to substantiate his title, embracing nights of sipping Opus One [his bold and impressive choice of wine] and indulging in group dinners at Cipriani — for the balance, of course,” Meghan noted.Rory McIlroy plays in the 96th PGA Championship in 2014. By: Frank Polich/MEGA“And yet, beyond his work/play ethic, the most endearing quality of this man is his character — as real and honest as they come, appreciating a simple smile, never shunning a fan photo, enjoying a plate of pasta with veal ragu and expressing a love for his parents that is rarely seen in men his age,” she continued. “Or at any age, to be honest. He is not just the real deal. He is real.”According to royal expert Tom Bower’s book Meghan, Harry, and the War Between the Windsors, the mother of two and the golf champion went on a few dates.The two reportedly dined at the Fitzpatrick Hotel in New York City and met in Ireland for a meal.Despite the rumors, Meghan was dating chef Cory Vitello, who allegedly asked her if she and McIlroy were more than friends.Meghan Markle attends the 3rd Annual NFL Characters Unite in 2014. By: Nancy Rivera/MEGA“Their time together was innocent,” Bower claimed. “The golfer was not her future.”The California native went on to marry Prince Harry in 2018. McIlroy wed his wife, Erica Stoll, in 2017.Azzi Fudd, Top Pick in WNBA Draft, Will Make $424K More Than Caitlin Clark Did as a RookieTue, April 14, 2026 at 7:27 PM UTCAzzi Fudd, Caitlin ClarkCredit: Amy Sussman/Getty; Jason Mendez/GettyNEED TO KNOWAzzi Fudd will earn $500,000 in her WNBA rookie campaignThe former UConn standout's salary is $424,000 more than Caitlin Clark made in her 2024 rookie seasonFudd will join girlfriend and 2025 rookie of the year Paige Bueckers on the Dallas Wings this seasonAzzi Fudd, the No. 1 pick of the 2026 WNBA Draft, is set to make big money in Big D.When the former UConn standout joins girlfriend Paige Bueckers, 24, on the Dallas Wings for the upcoming season, Fudd, 23, will take home $500,000 thanks to the new collective bargaining agreement (CBA) signed by players last month.Fudd’s salary is roughly $424,000 more than the $76,832 that Caitlin Clark earned in 2024, her first year in the league.Bueckers, last season’s rookie of the year, made $78,831 in 2025.Azzi Fudd and Paige Bueckers in April 2025Credit: The Hapa Blonde/GC ImagesStill, as the third No. 1 WNBA/NBA draft pick to go to Dallas in the last two years, Fudd’s compensation pales in comparison to Mavericks rookie Cooper Flagg’s paycheck.Flagg, 19, earned nearly $14 million for his freshman campaign — in which he’s in the running for rookie of the year — with the Mavericks.Before the new CBA went into effect, players across the league clamored for equal pay, given that the league’s popularity has soared since Clark’s arrival on the scene.Previous to the new agreement, the average WNBA base salary was around $102,000, while the NBA average is about $13 million, according to Spotrac's data analyzed by SI and Basketball Reference.In July 2025, WNBA players sent a message to the league ahead of playing in the WNBA All-Star Game by wearing warm-up shirts that read "Pay us what you owe us.""That’s one of the things we're in the room fighting for," Clark, who was a team captain, told USA Today of the plea at the time. "We should be paid more and hopefully that’s the case moving forward as the league continues to grow."As far as Fudd’s concerned, she’s excited to earn her keep."I can't wait. Obviously, Paige [Bueckers], Arike [Ogunbowale], getting to watch them and then seeing their new pieces,” she told reporters on Monday. “I'm so excited. I can't wait to get there. I can't wait to learn how to play with them, learn how they play, their style of play and how I can contribute.”Read the original article on People
